availability_audit: Cap-36 build for the window between Mt. Chimney (C22, cap 36) and Flannery (C23, cap 42). GARDEVOIR (Ralts wild Route102 gate 14 -> Kirlia L20 -> Gardevoir L30) with ITEM_GARDEVOIRITE (stone-window 14; Mega Ring from Steven after Brawly). EXCADRILL (Drilbur wild RusturfTunnel gate 20 -> Excadrill by level, gate 36) - new at this cap and the reason this party is stronger than my cap-30 one. MAGEARNA (legendary_sign RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F, gate 14; declared reachable legend). KARTANA (wild PetalburgWoods_3, gate 20). WEAVILE (Sneasel wild Seaspray_Cave_B1F gate 14, condition evolution). NIDOKING (Nidoran-M wild Route101 gate 14 -> Nidorino -> Moon Stone, gate 20). Still deliberately excluded at this cap: every NewMauville source (Zapdos, Regieleki, Zekrom, Zeraora, Magnezone, Iron Hands, Eelektross, Meltan/Melmetal), because the Game Book gates New Mauville behind Surf in C28; and every Route 111 desert species (Trapinch/Vibrava, Gible, Hippopotas/Hippowdon, Sandaconda, Silicobra, Cacnea/Cacturne, Stonjourner), because the Go-Goggles are handed over by the rival outside Flannery's Gym in C23, after this battle. Note that pool-36 newly lists Mega Charizard X and Y: Charizardite X sits in the Mt. Chimney meteorite machine cradle, which this chapter has just resolved, so it would arguably be legal, but I did not need a second Mega and did not use one. One reachable legend (Magearna) and one Mega (Gardevoir) are used and declared.
plan: The crack line for this pair names Rock pressure, Wide Guard, Soundproof/Ghost immunity and unsafe Boomburst beside Dodrio. Excadrill's spread Rock Slide is 4x on BOTH Normal/Flying birds at once, which is the single cleanest answer available at this cap, and Mold Breaker means Big Pecks and Soundproof cannot get in the way of anything. Mega Gardevoir supplies the fast spread, Magearna's Assault Vest absorbs the sound attacks and Weavile's Knock Off strips the Eviolite, the Choice Band and the Throat Spray.
